rationale: The core relaxed-vowel, preceding-note practice and breath preparation advice matches ku-006/ku-015, but prescriptions for an open throat, avoiding dynamic changes, isolated leaps to build muscle memory, and balancing diaphragm support with vocal-cord relaxation are material additions unsupported by either source.

Faithfully covers natural vowels and resonance, relaxed transitions without articulation/pitch tension, practice of preceding lower/middle notes, and preparing high-note space with the phrase-start breath as recommended in ku-006.
Matches ku-012: D.S. means Dal Segno, return to the Segno sign, and at the Coda indication jump to the next Coda sign.

Correctly expands Dal Segno al Coda and identifies the return to Segno, but compresses the later action into moving to Coda and finishing. Unlike ku-012, it does not distinguish the Coda cue from the next Coda sign, leaving the jump sequence ambiguous.
